market_blurb: Williamsport, Pennsylvania anchors Lycoming County with a diversified economy built on healthcare, higher education, and manufacturing. The city is world-famous as the home of the Little League World Series, which drives seasonal tourism, while natural gas industry activity from the Marcellus Shale region has also shaped the local economy. Major employers like UPMC Susquehanna and Pennsylvania College of Technology provide a stable economic base in Williamsport.

Many of the city's older homes have basements, and surrounding rural and suburban areas also feature crawl spaces, both of which trap humidity and create persistent conditions for indoor mold growth.
